summary: 10.0.39.02 Universal Transmit Email Modal Parity across Quotation, Sales & Purchase Returns
highlights: 1. Universal Transmit Email Modal: Completely replaced browser window.prompt() on Quotation and Return registers with the rich, modern, dark/light theme 3D card modal matching Sales and Purchase.
2. Auto-Populated Intelligence: Automatically pre-fills recipient email from customer/supplier master, dynamic subject line, and polite personalized message body.
3. Real-Time Attached PDF Preview: Integrated [👁 Preview PDF] button inside the email modal allowing users to inspect the generated PDF in lightbox before transmitting.

4. Dynamic Modal Context: Dynamically adapts modal title ('Transmit Quotation Estimate via Email' / 'Transmit Credit Note via Email'), subtitle, file attachment badge, and primary action button ('✈ Send Quotation' / '✈ Send Credit Note').
5. Resilient Attachment Generation: Transparently dispatches authentic server PDF or client-generated fallback PDF base64 directly through backend SMTP gateway.
